name: Mr. Mendoza
source:
A skilled toy-maker. Mr. Mendoza is a traditionalist who prefers classic, wooden toys over flashy, electronic ones. He has a variety of skills, like cooking and falling asleep sitting up. He has patience for everything except conflict. Mr. Mendoza is kind, sincere, and wise - Lyle seeks his advice often.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/karitsa/doki-doki-dollmaker-a-heartfelt-bl-visual-novel]Kickstarter[/url]]
